mapper.sql: select c.id, c.book_id, b.title book_title, c.chapter_name, c.chapter_no, c.content, char_length(replace(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(c.content, ''), ' ', ''), char(10), ''), char(13), ''), char(9), '')) word_count, c.del_flag, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark from px_book_chapter c join px_book b on b.id = c.book_id and b.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: where c.id = #{id} and c.create_by = #{userId} and c.del_flag = '0'

where c.book_id = #{chapter.bookId} and c.create_by = #{userId} and c.del_flag = '0' and (c.chapter_no < #{chapter.chapterNo} or (c.chapter_no = #{chapter.chapterNo} and c.id < #{chapter.id})) order by c.chapter_no desc, c.id desc limit 1

where c.book_id = #{chapter.bookId} and c.create_by = #{userId} and c.del_flag = '0' and (c.chapter_no > #{chapter.chapterNo} or (c.chapter_no = #{chapter.chapterNo} and c.id > #{chapter.id})) order by c.chapter_no asc, c.id asc limit 1
mapper.update: update px_book_chapter c join px_book b on b.id = c.book_id and b.create_by = #{updateBy} and b.del_flag = '0' set c.chapter_name = #{chapterName}, c.chapter_no = #{chapterNo}, c.content = #{content}, c.update_by = #{updateBy}, c.update_time = #{updateTime}, c.remark = #{remark} where c.id = #{id} and c.create_by = #{updateBy} and c.del_flag = '0'
